name: qkd_rst_region

pin_regs.reason: the regional reset root replaces ONE relay stage of a reset-tree chain (kv_die.py 2044: last stage of the region's chain) and its release calendar is compiled to that: the relayed level a is captured by its own flop (a_q, behind the ignore gate) and b is a flop output (rst_o), so both data pins are already registered at the face (io_flop_at_pins anchors them); dly[7:0] is a static die strap (tie cells, constant after power-up) and por_n is the package POR pad (async assert, two-flop synchronised inside). Extra pin registers would add 2 edges to every region's release and break the strap rule dly = D - d_r (release at host + D + 2 + L, generator RST_REGION_IGNORE).

structural_change: NEW leaf (ELEM-CENSUS 10-16, census class F, KV die lead go 10-16): v1.4.3 regional reset root qkd_rst_region (Q-KVSYS-DIE 5785c6cc2: POR-held local reset, relayed host level ignored for IGNORE=255 core cycles, release calendar strap dly = D - d_r, re-assert HOLD 128), ~30 flops, one ck root. Frame = the KV relay standard qkd_rlys_1 (12.96 x 12.96 um, the 1-b reset/boot tree hop frame under OT_KV_RLY_STD=1, kv_rly_std.STD[1]) that this root replaces as the last stage of each reset-region chain; a W / b E / ck S as qkd_rlys_1, straps dly + POR on N. 50 instances per KV die.
slot_change_request: takes the relay frame it replaces: kv_die.py 2044 (rly_<bid>_<n-1> -> master qkd_rst_region) with w,h of the tree-hop relay (OT_KV_RLY_STD=1: qkd_rlys_1 12.96 x 12.96 um). Ports a,b,ck,dly[7:0] bound by SPLIT_BINDINGS['qkd_rst_region'] (kv_die.py 358); por_n = package POR pad (by_design).

job.purpose: KV die v1.4.3 regional reset root leaf (50 per die), never kitted before (census 10-16). Bench = Q-KVSYS-DIE tb_qkd_rst_region (3 chains 40/150/200, local trees 5/60/120, release exactly host + D + 2 + L, re-assert + HOLD) with its two RTL mutants.
